meta.title: Better Workspace File Manager
meta.description: Adds file management to the Files tab: an upload button and drag-and-drop upload from your computer, multi-select (click, Shift, ⌘/Ctrl, drag box), a right-click menu to download as a file or ZIP, create folders, and delete with confirmation, dragging items onto a folder to move them, and dragging workspace files into a conversation as @path references or image attachments.
